intent: DOCUMENTED NEGATIVE RESULT -- not a working fixture, kept because the failure is the finding. Suspilne Kultura, Vakarchuk interview, 53:56 (VP9 1080p, 25/1 CFR, 80902 frames). shot-detect clusters it into 61 angles with no plateau and refuses to write a shot list: worst distance WITHIN an angle 0.0549 exceeds the closest distance BETWEEN two (0.0102), so a shot resembles another angle more than its own. Cause: every camera shares one black studio backdrop, so the background this method reads carries no signal; burned-in lower-third name cards make it worse by turning one camera into two. Masking the lower third and normalising contrast were both measured and neither helped -- the best margin of three variants was 0.47x where a usable one is well above 1.0. Telling these angles apart needs person identity, not appearance.

stage0_shot_detect._note: The refusal is correct behaviour, not a bug. Downstream this would have built one full-length tape per phantom angle.
